description: Sent to a student when an item they have on loan is recalled because another student has reserved it. Asks them to return it by the new, earlier due date.
subject: Please return: {{book_title}} has been recalled
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Another student is waiting for a title you currently have on loan, so we've recalled it:

  Item:         {{book_title}}
  New due date: {{new_due}}

Please return it to the library desk by the new due date so we can pass it on. Items kept past a recall date accrue overdue charges as normal.

Thanks for helping us share resources fairly.

{{system_name}} Library
